definitions.explanation: The political revolution of 1868 that ended the Tokugawa shogunate and restored imperial rule under Emperor Meiji. It marked the beginning of Japan's rapid modernization and transformation from a feudal society into an industrialized nation.

examples.japanese: {明治維新|めいじいしん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1868⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
{明治維新|めいじいしん}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Japan changed dramatically as a result of the Meiji Restoration.

examples.japanese: {明治維新|めいじいしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{志士|しし}たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{近代|きんだい}→近代：02663_kindai⟧⟦{国家|こっか}→国家：02760_kokka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}した→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: The patriots of the Meiji Restoration aimed to build a modern nation.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
The {明治維新|めいじいしん} was the political upheaval that ended over 260 years of Tokugawa shogunate rule. Key events include the return of political authority to the Emperor ({大政奉還|たいせいほうかん}) and the abolition of the feudal domain system ({廃藩置県|はいはんちけん}). It led to sweeping reforms in government, education, military, and industry.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {明治維新|めいじいしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{功労者|こうろうしゃ} (contributors to the Meiji Restoration)
- {明治維新|めいじいしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{志士|しし} (Restoration patriots)
- {明治維新|めいじいしん}⟦{以降|いこう}→以降：03999_ikou⟧ (since the Meiji Restoration)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{維新|いしん}→維新：13869_ishin⟧ alone means "restoration" or "reform" and can be used independently, though it most commonly refers to the Meiji Restoration. ⟦{革命|かくめい}→革命：05968_kakumei⟧ (revolution) implies a more radical overthrow, while ⟦{維新|いしん}→維新：13869_ishin⟧ emphasizes renewal and restoration.
